title: Learning & Development Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Learning & Development Coordinator for our client on a temporary basis. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive L&D professional with practical experience of managing and supporting a Learning Management System (LMS).Working closely with HR, managers, and employees, you will play a key role in coordinating learning activities, maintaining training records, supporting compliance training programmes, and ensuring a positive user experience across the organisation's LMS platform.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate and administer learning and development activities across the organisation.
- Manage day-to-day activity within the Learning Management System (LMS).
- Upload, maintain and update learning content, courses and user records.
- Monitor training completion rates and produce regular management reports.
- Support onboarding and mandatory training programmes.
- Act as the first point of contact for LMS-related queries and troubleshooting.
- Schedule training sessions and liaise with internal and external training providers.
- Maintain accurate learning records and ensure compliance requirements are met.
- Support wider people initiatives and continuous improvement projects within the HR and L&D functions.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous experience in a Learning & Development, Training or HR Coordination role.
- Practical, hands-on experience using and administering a Learning Management System (LMS).
- Strong administrative and organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience producing reports and analysing training data.
- Confident communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable
- Experience supporting compliance training programmes.
- CIPD qualification or relevant L&D certification.

What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Client Coordinator
description:
Client Coordinator

Shrewsbury

Temporary - Permanent

Monday-Friday, 8:30am 5:00pm

Salary £28000 - £33000

Annual leave 25 days + Bank Holidays when the role goes permanent

We are looking for an organised, proactive and customer-focused Client Coordinator to support the delivery of smaller projects across a varied client portfolio. Working alongside Technical Project Managers you will coordinate the administrative and operational activity required to keep projects moving from initial instruction through to completion.

This is a busy, varied role requiring someone who can manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate records and communicate confidently with customers, engineers, subcontractors and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Workflow Coordination
- Coordinate multiple projects, ensuring actions, deadlines and requirements are followed through.
- Support Technical Project Managers with scheduling, mobilisation and ongoing project administration.
- Coordinate engineer and subcontractor attendance, materials and other project requirements.
- Raise and track subcontractor work orders and monitor progress through to completion.
- Maintain accurate project trackers and proactively highlight delays, risks or issues.
- Support quotations, purchase orders, variations, uplifts and invoicing.

Systems & Administration
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within the CRM system.
- Update job statuses, costs, documentation, subcontractor information and project progress.
- Ensure project documentation is complete, accurate and consistently maintained.
- Assist with reporting, KPI tracking and general system administration.

Customer & Stakeholder Management
- Act as a key point of contact for customers, subcontractors and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle.
- Respond to queries professionally and provide clear, proactive updates.
- Build strong working relationships with customers and operational teams.
- Support Project Managers and Senior Management with regular project updates.

Compliance & Commercial Support
- Ensure projects follow internal processes and required governance procedures.
- Support the collation of project handover documentation.
- Assist with tracking project costs, variations and operational updates.
- Help ensure projects are delivered on time, within agreed requirements and in line with company procedures.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and operational efficiency.

About You

We are looking for someone who is highly organised, commercially aware and comfortable working in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.

You will ideally have:
- Experience in project coordination, administration or a similar operational role.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple live projects and competing priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail and confidence working with systems, documentation and data.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the confidence to identify and escalate issues when required.
- Good IT skills and experience using business management or project systems.

The application process:

Our mission is to support our clients in their creation of an equal, diverse and inclusive workforce. We are committed to providing a barrier-free recruitment process, so if you require any reasonable accessibility adjustments within the application process, then please make it known at the earliest opportunity.

We will carefully consider your details and advise you if we're able to progress with your application within 72 working hours. If you do not hear from us within this time your details won t be retained. So, if you're not successful on this occasion, do continue to respond to future roles we advertise. In the meantime, all good wishes and continued success with your search for employment.

About Us

Prince Personnel are an employment agency working on behalf of our client. Whether you re seeking a new permanent position, temporary assignment or contract you ll find us easy to deal with. Located in thriving Telford, we focus on jobs in Shropshire, Staffordshire and North Wales. Prince Personnel specialise in commercial, accounts and finance and technical recruitment. With the best jobs around we are an independent agency working hard for you.

title: Call Handler
company: Shropshire Doctors Co-operative Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Call Handler

Location: Shrewsbury

Salary: £12.94 per hour (with a 30% uplift when working between 8pm and 8am on weekdays and for Saturday shifts, 60% uplift on Sundays and Bank Holidays)

Vacancy Type: Permanent, Part-time (18 hours per week)

Closing Date: 09/09/2026

About us:

Shropdoc is a not-for-profit company established in 1996. Our core services include Out of Hours (OOH) GP care, urgent care triage, home visiting, and face-to-face clinical services. We work collaboratively with NHS partners and other health and care organisations to ensure patients receive safe, responsive, and high-quality care when their usual GP practice is closed or when urgent support is needed.

Shropdoc's mission is to 'keep the patient at the heart of all that we do'. We aim to achieve excellence in the care we offer to our patients, providing a safe and high-quality service that is easily accessible. We strive to provide quality patient care, a working community with integrity and kindness, and are committed to continually developing our staff. Our vision and values of Community, Quality, Kindness, Integrity, and Development are at the heart of all that we do, enabling us to achieve the best outcomes for patients and for our colleagues.

The Person:

We are looking for a highly organised, flexible individual with experience together with the following skills:
- Call handling or phone-based customer service experience.
- An excellent telephone manner, with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Good geographical knowledge of the Powys area is desirable.
- Ability to prioritise, work on your own initiative, and as part of a team.
- Discretion and integrity with the ability to handle confidential information.
- Experience of working across multiple computer platforms and using data systems.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
- Although not essential, as full training will be provided, experience gained in a healthcare setting, call centre or hospitality environment would be advantageous.

The Role - Call Handler

As a Call Handler, you will coordinate and facilitate the care of patients being admitted to hospital from Health Care Professionals, GP Practices and our own Clinicians by:
- Acting as a single point of contact for Clinicians accessing emergency secondary care.
- Making outbound calls and handling incoming calls from patients, health care professionals and services, fast tracking to the appropriate services.
- Arranging outpatient appointments and hospital admissions.
- Working directly with health care professionals and patients over the phone, via email and electronic fax.
- Accurately entering patient data into our systems.
- Providing administrative support to colleagues and clinicians.

What We Offer:
- Competitive salary and benefits package: Benefits include access to the NHS Pension Scheme, cycle to work scheme, Generous holiday allowance, sick pay, Employee Assistance health programme (Paycare).
- A supportive and inclusive work environment: Join a team that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.
- Work-life balance: We understand the importance of work-life balance and will discuss hours with the successful candidate.

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Shropdoc, please click apply to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

At Shropdoc, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all individuals, including those with disabilities, are valued and supported. We encourage applications from candidates with disabilities and are dedicated to providing the necessary adjustments to ensure success in the role.

In line with our Armed Forces Covenant, we guarantee an interview to any applicant who meets all of the essential criteria listed in the person specification.

Shropdoc is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our patients and expects all staff, contractors and volunteers to share this commitment. Candidates will undergo thorough onboarding and safeguarding checks including checks with the Disclosure and Barring Service.

description:

£20,000 £30,000 + Bonus Permanent Shifnal, TF11

- Speaking with candidates and clients by telephone and email

Who are we looking for?

Personality is really important to us.

We re looking for someone who is:
- Bubbly, friendly and approachable

title: Sales Support Executive - International
description:
Sales Support Executive International

Location: High Shropshire Office Based

Ready to take your career to the next level in an exciting, growing international business?

Our client is experiencing a sustained period of sales growth, with their international and export business playing an increasingly important role in that success. As they continue to grow, they are looking for an enthusiastic, highly organised Sales Support Executive - International to join their close-knit Customer Support Team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, responsibility and working at pace, while putting customer satisfaction at the heart of everything they do.

As Sales Support Executive, you ll play a key role in supporting the Sales Team and Sales Director, helping to keep international orders moving smoothly from initial enquiry through to delivery. In return, you ll have the opportunity to develop your skills, broaden your experience and build a rewarding career within a growing business.

Could this be you?

We're looking for someone who is a genuine team player, enjoys solving problems and takes pride in delivering an excellent customer experience. You ll need to be organised, commercially aware and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a busy environment.

Export documentation and freight forwarding experience is desirable, but not essential. We would be delighted to hear from exceptional candidates who have the right attitude, aptitude and customer-focused approach, even if they don't have direct experience in these areas. Full training and support can be provided to the right person.

Responsibilities
- Supporting the Sales Team with day-to-day administrative and operational activities.
- Processing international/export orders from receipt through to shipment and delivery.
- Preparing and maintaining export documentation, including commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin and shipping instructions.
- Working closely with production, warehouse, logistics providers and freight forwarders to ensure orders are delivered on time.
- Monitoring order progress and proactively keeping customers and internal teams updated.
- Responding to customer queries regarding products, pricing, orders, shipping schedules and documentation.
- Managing multiple email inboxes and ensuring customer enquiries are followed through to resolution.
- Maintaining accurate customer, sales and export information within ERP/CRM systems.
- Assisting with quotations, sales reports, forecasts and performance reporting.
- Working with Finance on payment terms and export documentation requirements.
- Supporting compliance with international trade regulations, export controls and customs requirements.
- Resolving customer, shipment and documentation issues quickly and effectively.
- Supporting the Sales Team with presentations, contracts and tender documentation.
- Identifying opportunities for continuous improvement across export processes and customer service.

What We're Looking For

Ideally, you'll have experience within export sales support, international customer service, freight forwarding or export operations, together with knowledge of areas such as Incoterms, export documentation and customs procedures. However, we're not necessarily looking for someone who can tick every box.

If you have strong administration and organisational skills, excellent attention to detail, first-class customer service skills and the ability to learn quickly, we would love to hear from you even if export or freight forwarding is new to you.

We're looking for someone who can demonstrate:
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
- A proactive, problem-solving approach.
- Strong customer service skills and a genuine desire to help customers.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Experience with ERP/CRM systems would be advantageous.
- A willingness to learn, develop and take on new responsibilities.

Why Join?

This is more than just a sales support executive role. It's an opportunity to become a key member of a growing international business, develop specialist export knowledge and work closely with the Sales Director and wider team.

If you're ambitious, organised, customer-focused and looking for a role where no two days are the same, we'd love to hear from you.

Your attitude, potential and ability to learn could be just as important as your previous experience.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
We are currently representing a fantastic client who is actively seeking a diligent and experienced Accounts Assistant to join their established finance department. Our client is looking for a capable professional who can hit the ground running, take ownership of the day-to-day transactional finance duties, and ensure the smooth running of the accounts function.

If you have a solid background in finance and are looking for a stable, fast-paced role within a supportive and growing business, this is an excellent opportunity to make a valued impact.

Key Responsibilities
- Ledger Management: Take full ownership of both the purchase and sales ledgers, ensuring all invoices are processed, coded, and authorized accurately and efficiently.
- Reconciliations: Perform regular and accurate bank, supplier, and credit card statement reconciliations.
- Credit Control: Proactively monitor debtor balances, chase outstanding payments via phone and email, and resolve any invoicing disputes.
- Payment Runs: Prepare weekly or bi-weekly supplier payment runs for management approval.
- Month-End Support: Assist the wider finance team with month-end preparations, including journal postings, accruals, and prepayments.
- Expenses: Process employee expense claims in line with company policy.

What Our Client is Looking For
- Proven, hands-on experience working as an Accounts Assistant or in a similar transactional finance role.
- AAT qualification (Level 3 or 4) is highly advantageous, though qualified by experience (QBE) candidates will be strongly considered.
- Strong IT proficiency, particularly in Microsoft Excel (e.g., VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) and previous experience using accounting software (e.g., Xero, Sage, QuickBooks).
- High level of numeracy and exceptional attention to detail.
- Excellent communication skills and the confidence to liaise effectively with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers/clients.
